crossRefs.note: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for…

translations.web: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”
translations.bsb: That was why his parents said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
translations.kjv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
translations.asv: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
